items.question: State the Biot–Savart law and use it to explain the magnetic field lines and the magnetic field at the centre of a circular coil.
items.subject: physics
items.schema_text: <|bos|><|board=NEB|><|level=C12|><|subj=physics|><|unit|>Electrons<|marks=5|><|type=CONCEPTUAL|><|q|>State the Biot–Savart law and use it to explain the magnetic field lines and the magnetic field at the centre of a circular coil.<|sol|>Outline: $B = \mu_0I/2\pi r$; $B = -B\sin\theta/2\pi d$; $\cos\theta = \mu_1/2\pi$; $\tan\theta = \mu$; $\sin\theta = \mu/\mu_0$; $\theta = \tan\theta/2$; $\mu_r = \mu_r/2\pi = \mu_2/2\pi/2\pi m$; $e = \mu_s I/2\pi\sqrt{\mu_0I_b^2/2\mu_0}$; $N = \tan\theta = \mu + \mu_0\sin^2\theta/2\mu$.<|end|>
